text: The Board will consider committee member appointments and size of committees.

Increased the composition of the Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee to 6 members and appointed the following Members: Kevin Garland, as Chair Councillor Paula Fletcher Steven Levitan Cynthia Lickers-Sage Gabriel Michaan Gillian Smith 3. Reduced the composition of the Risk Committee to 4 members and appointed the following Members: Robert Foster, as Chair Councillor John Filion Kevin Garland Steven Levitan 4. Changed the name of the Policies and Priorities Committee to the Planning and Priorities Committee. 5.
